slides.title: Code That Looks Good
slides.subtitle: Drop in your scripts, JSON, or commands with beautiful syntax highlighting.
slides.codeContent:
#!/bin/bash

# Clone the OpenDeck repository
git clone https://github.com/chrisglaske/opendeck.git

# Open directly in any browser
# No build tools, no npm install, no servers needed.
open index.html

echo "Happy Presenting! 🎉"
